msContents.summary: A palm-leaf manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya, bundled with the Dhanurmāsamāhātmya.

supportDesc.condition: Significant loss around the left and right margins.

lg.l: kathayaṃtaṃ hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvāt paramādbhutāt
tatvajñaṃ paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana |
ekataḥ kratavas sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |

ekato bhayabhīta
prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ |
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |
iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiber auśīnarasya ca |
vartamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śibiṃ nṛpaṃ |

iṃdra śyemaḥ kapo gnir bhūtvā
pajagmatuḥ |
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapota śyenajād bhayāt |
śaraṇārthī mahīpāla nililye bhayavihvalaḥ |
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |

rājānaṃ hi mahāprājaṃ provācedaṃ
dā |
mahārāja kapoto yaṃ vidhātrā vihito mama |
bhakṣyo bubhuktā mahatī vartate visṛjāsra taṃ |
kapoto yam atitrasyaś śaraṇārthī samāgataḥ |
tasmān na visṛjyāmy enaṃ dharmo me bhī
dharmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ dharmaṃ mahībhutāṃ |
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ dharmaṃ cikīrṣasi |
bhavān kṛtaghniṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ |
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇām asādhuṃ sādhunā
pakārapareṣv evam upakāraparo bhavāt |
ahite tvaṃ hitaḥ pāpe tvam apāpo hi sarvadā |
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ |
sadaiva vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |

mā hīṃsī
lobhena dharmam utsṛjya mānase |
saṃtrastarūpaḥ trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ |
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnurayaṃ khagaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya mayārthinaḥ |

katham asma
dhaḥ kuryus tyāgaṃ sarvavigarhitam |
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajeccharaṇāgataṃ |
brahmahatyāsaman tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |

śaraṇāgata
s tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit |
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇās sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare
te mṛtyos trasyaṃti te tataḥ |
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāso vā krodha eva vā |
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāṃtam api taṃ tyajet |
mariṣyāmīti yaduḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |

śakyaṃ tenānumānena paro
parirakṣituṃ |
yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |
saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ |
tasmān nāham amaṃ bhīnam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ |

yad atra ma
kartuṃ yuktaṃ śyenāśu tad vada |
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti nareśvara |
āhāreṇaiva vardhaṃte te jīvaṃti caiva hi |
śakyate duṣkare py arthe cirarātreṇa jīvituṃ |

sarvāhāravihīnasya na tu vartayituṃ ci
rat |
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsmāt mama prāṇā viśāṃpate |
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ |
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāraṃ vinaśyati |
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi |

dharmaṃ
yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ paraṃtapa |
avirodhī tu yo dharmas sa dharmas sadbhir ucyate |
tasmād virodhe dharmasya viciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ |
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan kura dharmavinirṇayaṃ |

nāto bhūyāṃs tato dharmaḥ
kaścid anyo hi khecara |
prāṇinām eva bhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate |
varam etasya satvasya pradattaṃ jīvitābhayaṃ |
na ca viprasahasrasya gosahasram dine dine |
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāras sulabhā bhuvi |

durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sa
rvabhūtadayāparaḥ |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthaṃ vedāś śru
taṃ tathā |
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ |
catussāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ |
abhayas sarvabhūtebhyas tayor abhayado varaḥ |
tyaje sarvam idaṃ rājyaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ |

na tv amaṃ bha
yavitrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ |
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani |
bhaves trātā bhayārtānām ārtināśāya dehināṃ |
na svargaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na lokaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ |

kāmaye duḥkhataptānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhayanā
śanaṃ |
tad ahaṃ nānṛtāṃ vācaṃ vipadāvas tu dīraye |
satyenānena bhagavān prasīdatu janārdanaḥ |
āhārārthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama |
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmy ahaṃ |

sa eva vihito smā
dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam evotsṛja nāhāraiḥ kāryam asty aparair mama |
śyenāḥ kapotān khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan sāram ajñātvā kadalīstaṃbham āruhaḥ |

nāhaṃ duḥśāstramārge
kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmas sarvadayāparaḥ |
sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā |
sarvasatvapradānāc ca dayaikasmin viśiṣyate | 47 |

sarve vedā na tat kuryus sa
rve yajñāś ca khecara |
sarve tīrthābhiṣekāś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā |
vāṅ_manaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtadayī ratāḥ |
ātmavat parirakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ |

prāṇino vadhyamānāṃ
s tu śaktas samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
rājyaṃ śibīnāṃ sakalaṃ prayacchāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ |
yadi rājan kapote te sudṛḍhā bhaktir īdṛśī
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me |
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase |

etat te haṃ praya
cchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icchasi |
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaś cirād vadati vā na vā |
mamāpi priyamem evaitat kasmāyābhihitaṃ tvayācirāt |
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |

dhruvaṃ yo nārjeyed dha
rmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ |
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopapadyate |
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā |

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃ
saṃ nareśvara |
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayacca tulayā dhṛtaṃ |
taccaivāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase |
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tad vartaya vihaṃgama |

evam uktvā
svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭas tulayāmāsa kapotena samaṃ prabhuḥ |
tyaktātmā sukhabhogecchas sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |
bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ |
dhṛyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto hy atiricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ pradāt sa pārthivaḥ |
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |

tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tu
lāṃ svayaṃ |
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nāpekṣaṃte svam ātmānaṃ svasukhāni mahāṃty api |
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe |
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca |
atha tasya tadā matvā dharmarāja parāṃ dhṛtiṃ |

śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya
vākyam etad abhāṣata |
iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau |
naitat pūrve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare |

mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣka
raṃ tvayā |
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇānyā prītir abhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃśayalabdheṣu na hi prāṇiṣu dehināṃ |
parārthaikāṃtakalyāṇī svārthe cātyaṃtaniśpṛhā |

tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan karuṇā karu
ṇāyate |
svakarmapāśais sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat |
tvaṃ jagaduḥkhamokṣāya baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa |
yathā sarvātmanā vāpi dehiṣu prahataṃ tvayā |

yathā caivātmasaṃtrāṇe hīnāna
navamatya ca |
akṛtvā sadṛśe sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ | 72 |
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇānyo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yato nāvartate punaḥ |

prāṇair api tvayā rājan rakṣi
taḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsānīha dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā |
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ |
sa punar jīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parārthaṃ hi jīvati |
kiṃ cātra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ || - ||
na hi svadehaśaityā yad jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ |
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā |
sa padaṃ tāvad āpnoti parād api hi yat param |
paropakārakāri yas svasukhāya gataspṛhaḥ |

jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādha
s tādṛśā bhuvi |
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyas samutkṛttāni pārthiva |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir lokān anugāmiṣyati |
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinīṃ |
sarvān lokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi |

e
m uktvā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ |
rājā tu kratum iṣṭvāsau mumude devavac ciraṃ |
ya idaṃ śuṇuyā nityaṃ śibeś caritam uttamaṃ |
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ |

viciṃtya rājā sva
rīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśas sarvajanasya durllabhaṃ |
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || - ||

body.p: iti śrī itihāsamuccaye śyenakapotīyākhyānaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ |
